title: Mobility Equipment Fee Notice — Portable-Oxygen Mount Fee for Home Oxygen Therapy Patients
content:
# Portable-Oxygen Mount Fee on a Cash-Sale Chair Given Back — Mobility Equipment

**Notice.** When a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash is given back, a portable-oxygen mount fee is withheld from the refund when the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record is rental active or payment cap reached: 85.00 when its portable equipment is a portable oxygen concentrator (E1392), 35.00 when it is a cylinder, home-fill or liquid portable (E0431, K0738 or E0434), and nothing when there is no such oxygen record or no portable equipment.

## Reading the oxygen record

The status of the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record and the portable equipment code of its oxygen class. A Home Oxygen Therapy record in any status other than rental active or payment cap reached counts as no such record.

| Portable equipment (oxygen record rental active or payment cap reached) | Mount fee withheld (USD) |
|---|---|
| portable oxygen concentrator (E1392) | 85.00 |
| portable cylinders (E0431) | 35.00 |
| home-fill system (K0738) | 35.00 |
| liquid oxygen portable (E0434) | 35.00 |
| no portable equipment | nothing |

**Hypothetical case.** A patient with a Home Oxygen Therapy liquid system that has reached its payment cap gives back a cash-sale chair: 35.00 withheld. A patient whose oxygen rental is suspended: nothing withheld.
